safetyCue: Stop if you feel pain or dizziness.
notes: Human-written sessions. The coach only selects a session and sets its length; it never writes exercises. intensity = the highest readiness cap the session needs (rest < easy < moderate < any). Steps: minutes = fixed time, fill = takes the remaining time, reps/sets = strength sets (scaled), holdSec/sides = stretch holds (scaled), pattern [in, hold, out, hold] + rounds = breathing (scaled). Zones are % of max HR (Z1 50-60, Z2 60-70, Z3 70-80, Z4 80-90, Z5 90-100) and are shown in bpm by Swift.

sessions.name: Cyclic sighing
sessions.summary: Two inhales, one long exhale. Five minutes lifted mood more than mindfulness in a Stanford trial.

steps.label: Settle
steps.cue: Sit or lie down. Let your shoulders drop and breathe normally.

steps.label: Cyclic sigh
steps.cue: Breathe in through the nose, then take a short second sip of air to fill up. Let it all out slowly through the mouth.

steps.label: Rest
steps.cue: Return to normal breathing and notice how you feel.

sessions.name: Slow breathing, 6 a minute
sessions.summary: Even breaths at about six a minute. Breathing under ten a minute is linked to calmer heart rhythms.

steps.label: Settle
steps.cue: Sit upright with one hand on your belly.

steps.label: Slow breathing
steps.cue: Breathe in through the nose so your belly rises, then out gently. Smooth, not forced.

steps.label: Rest
steps.cue: Let your breath find its own pace.

sessions.name: Box breathing
sessions.summary: Four equal sides: in, hold, out, hold. A steady rhythm to reset before a meeting or a race.

steps.label: Settle
steps.cue: Sit tall, feet flat on the floor.

steps.label: Box breathing
steps.cue: Picture tracing the sides of a square. Keep the holds relaxed, never strained. Shorten them to 3 s if 4 feels hard.

steps.label: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe normally for a few breaths before you get up.

sessions.name: Breathing to fall asleep
sessions.summary: Exhales twice as long as inhales, lying in bed with the lights off.

steps.label: Lie down
steps.cue: Lights off, phone face down out of reach. Lie on your back or side.

steps.label: Long exhale
steps.cue: In through the nose, out slowly through pursed lips. If you lose count, just start again.

steps.label: Let go
steps.cue: Stop counting and let your breathing run on its own.

sessions.name: Three-minute calm reset
sessions.summary: A short reset you can do at a desk when stress has been running high.

steps.label: Two big sighs
steps.cue: Double inhale through the nose, long sigh out through the mouth.

steps.label: Slow breaths
steps.cue: Soften your jaw and hands. Each exhale a little longer than the inhale.

steps.label: Look around
steps.cue: Let your eyes rest on something far away before you go back to work.

sessions.name: Body scan
sessions.summary: Slow breathing while you relax one body area at a time, feet to face.

steps.label: Settle
steps.cue: Lie on your back, arms by your sides. Breathe slowly through the nose.

steps.label: Feet and legs
steps.cue: Notice your feet, calves, knees and thighs. On each exhale let them feel heavier.

steps.label: Hips and belly
steps.cue: Let your belly rise and fall. Release your lower back into the floor.

steps.label: Chest and shoulders
steps.cue: Let your shoulders sink away from your ears.

steps.label: Face and jaw
steps.cue: Unclench your jaw, soften your forehead and eyes.

sessions.name: Wind-down routine
sessions.summary: Ten quiet minutes before bed: dim lights, gentle stretches, slow breathing.

steps.label: Dim the lights
steps.cue: Lights low, screens away, room cool. Set tomorrow’s alarm now so you can stop checking.

steps.label: Child’s pose
steps.cue: Knees wide, arms long, forehead down. Breathe into your back.

steps.label: Lying knee hug
steps.cue: On your back, hug one knee to your chest, other leg long.

steps.label: Legs up the wall
steps.cue: Lie close to a wall with your legs resting up it. Arms relaxed.

steps.label: Long-exhale breathing
steps.cue: In through the nose, slowly out through the mouth.

sessions.name: Long wind-down
sessions.summary: A slower evening routine for nights when your mind is busy.

steps.label: Write it down
steps.cue: Jot tomorrow’s top three tasks on paper so they can leave your head.

steps.label: Dim the lights
steps.cue: Lights low, phone on its charger outside reach.

steps.label: Cat-cow
steps.cue: On hands and knees, round then gently arch your back with your breath.

steps.label: Child’s pose
steps.cue: Knees wide, forehead down, slow breaths into your back.

steps.label: Supine twist
steps.cue: On your back, let both knees fall to one side. Shoulders stay down.

steps.label: Body scan
steps.cue: In bed, relax each area from feet to face on the exhale.

steps.label: Long-exhale breathing
steps.cue: Lights off. In through the nose, slowly out.

sessions.name: Five-minute wind-down
sessions.summary: The short version for late nights.

steps.label: Screens away
steps.cue: Phone face down, out of reach. Lights off or very low.

steps.label: Neck release
steps.cue: Sitting on the bed, tip one ear toward the shoulder. No pulling.

steps.label: Forward fold
steps.cue: Sitting, legs long, fold forward gently with soft knees.

steps.label: Long-exhale breathing
steps.cue: Lying down. In through the nose, slowly out through the mouth.

sessions.name: Rest-day routine

steps.label: Hip flexor stretch
steps.cue: Half-kneel, tuck your tailbone and shift forward gently.

steps.label: Hamstring stretch
steps.cue: Heel on a low step, hinge forward with a straight back.

steps.label: Thread the needle

steps.label: Slow breathing

steps.label: Cat-cow
steps.cue: Slow, with your breath.

steps.label: Thread the needle

steps.label: Chin tucks
steps.cue: Slide your chin straight back, hold 2 s.

steps.label: Wall angels
steps.cue: Back against a wall, slide your arms up and down like a snow angel.

steps.label: Standing forward fold
steps.cue: Soft knees, let your head hang heavy.

steps.label: Standing quad stretch
steps.cue: Hold a desk for balance, knees together.

steps.label: Doorway chest stretch
steps.cue: Step through the door frame until the chest opens.

steps.label: Shoulder rolls
steps.cue: Slow and big.

steps.label: Cat-cow
steps.cue: Focus on moving your upper back.

steps.label: Thread the needle
steps.cue: Rest your shoulder and temple on the floor.

steps.label: Open book

steps.label: Neck side stretch
steps.cue: Ear toward shoulder, no pulling.

steps.label: Child’s pose

steps.label: Cat-cow
steps.cue: Slow, with your breath.

steps.label: Hip circles

steps.label: Calf stretch

steps.label: Hamstring stretch

sessions.name: Easy walk
sessions.summary: A relaxed walk. The lightest way to move on a low day.

steps.label: Easy walk

steps.label: Slow down
steps.cue: Ease off for the last couple of minutes.

sessions.name: After-meal walk
sessions.summary: Ten to twenty easy minutes after lunch or dinner.

steps.label: Easy walk

sessions.name: Brisk walk, Zone 2

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: Start at an easy stroll.

steps.label: Brisk walk
steps.cue: Walk like you’re a little late. You can talk, but not sing.

steps.label: Cool down
steps.cue: Slow to an easy stroll.

sessions.name: Step boost walk
sessions.summary: A short walk to top up a quiet day. About 100 steps a minute.

steps.label: Walk
steps.cue: Comfortable pace. A loop around the block or up and down stairs both count.

sessions.name: Hill walk
sessions.summary: Walking on hills or stairs. Steady effort, short steps on the climbs.

steps.label: Warm up on the flat
steps.cue: Easy pace.

steps.label: Hills

steps.label: Cool down

steps.label: Cool down

steps.label: Easy run

steps.label: Steady

steps.cue: Feet wide, hips still.

sessions.name: Bodyweight intervals
sessions.summary: Short hard rounds of strength moves. Green days only.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: March, arm circles, easy squats and lunges.

steps.label: Squat jumps or fast squats
steps.cue: Land softly. Fast squats without the jump are fine.

steps.label: Push-up
steps.cue: Any version, good form.

steps.label: Mountain climbers
steps.cue: Hands under shoulders, steady rhythm.

steps.label: Cool down walk
steps.cue: Walk until your breathing settles.

sessions.name: Light dumbbell session
sessions.summary: Light weights and smooth reps. Stop each set with 3 reps still in reserve.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: March, arm circles, 8 bodyweight squats.

steps.label: Goblet squat
steps.cue: Hold one dumbbell at your chest. Light weight, full control.

steps.label: One-arm row
steps.cue: Hand on a bench or chair, pull to your hip.

steps.label: Romanian deadlift
steps.cue: Soft knees, push your hips back, flat back.

steps.label: Floor press
steps.cue: Lying down, press up, elbows at 45 degrees.

steps.label: Suitcase carry
steps.cue: One dumbbell at your side, walk tall without leaning.

sessions.name: Dumbbell full body A
sessions.summary: Squat, press, row and hinge. Pick a weight that leaves 1 to 2 reps in reserve.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: March, arm circles, 8 bodyweight squats, 8 hip hinges.

steps.label: Goblet squat
steps.cue: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom, chest tall.

steps.label: Dumbbell bench or floor press
steps.cue: Lower slowly, press up smoothly.

steps.label: One-arm row
steps.cue: Flat back, pull to your hip.

steps.label: Romanian deadlift
steps.cue: Hips back, dumbbells close to your legs.

steps.label: Dead bug
steps.cue: Lower back down, exhale as you reach.

sessions.name: Dumbbell full body B
sessions.summary: The partner to session A: lunges, overhead press, rows and carries.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: Leg swings, arm circles, 5 lunges each side.

steps.label: Reverse lunge
steps.cue: Dumbbells at your sides, upright chest.

steps.label: Overhead press
steps.cue: Seated or standing, ribs down, press straight up.

steps.label: Chest-supported row
steps.cue: Chest on an inclined bench, or hinge forward with a flat back.

steps.label: Hip thrust
steps.cue: Upper back on a sofa, dumbbell on your hips, squeeze at the top.

steps.label: Farmer carry
steps.cue: Heavy dumbbells at your sides, tall posture, short steps.

sessions.name: Dumbbell upper body
sessions.summary: Press, row, shoulders and arms.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: Arm circles, band or light-dumbbell shoulder rotations.

steps.label: Floor or bench press
steps.cue: Control the way down.

steps.label: One-arm row
steps.cue: Pull to the hip, no twisting.

steps.label: Overhead press
steps.cue: Ribs down, press straight up.

steps.label: Lateral raise
steps.cue: Light weight, raise to shoulder height.

steps.label: Biceps curl to press
steps.cue: Smooth, no swinging.

sessions.name: Dumbbell lower body
sessions.summary: Squat, hinge, single-leg and calves.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: Leg swings, 8 bodyweight squats, 8 hip hinges.

steps.label: Goblet squat
steps.cue: Slow down, drive up.

steps.label: Romanian deadlift
steps.cue: Hips back, flat back, feel the hamstrings.

steps.label: Step-up
steps.cue: On a sturdy step or low bench. Push through the top foot.

steps.label: Calf raise
steps.cue: Dumbbell in one hand, the other on a wall.

sessions.name: Dumbbell power circuit
sessions.summary: A brisk circuit with short rests. Green days only.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: March, squats, hinges and arm circles.

steps.label: Dumbbell thruster
steps.cue: Squat, then press overhead in one movement. Moderate weight.

steps.label: Renegade row
steps.cue: Plank on the dumbbells, feet wide, row without twisting. Knees down is fine.

steps.label: Dumbbell swing
steps.cue: Hinge and snap your hips. The arms just guide the weight.

steps.label: Cool down walk
steps.cue: Walk and breathe slowly.

sessions.name: Gym machine circuit
sessions.summary: Simple machines for every main muscle group. 1 to 2 reps in reserve.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: Bike or cross-trainer, easy.

steps.label: Leg press
steps.cue: Feet shoulder width, don’t lock your knees.

steps.label: Chest press
steps.cue: Handles at mid-chest, smooth tempo.

steps.label: Lat pulldown
steps.cue: Pull the bar to your upper chest, shoulders down.

steps.label: Seated row
steps.cue: Chest up, squeeze your shoulder blades.

steps.label: Hamstring curl
steps.cue: Slow on the way back.

sessions.name: Easy swim
sessions.summary: Relaxed, continuous swimming in any stroke you like.

steps.label: Warm up
steps.cue: Easy lengths, any stroke.

steps.label: Steady swim
steps.cue: Smooth and relaxed. Rest at the wall whenever you want.

steps.label: Cool down
steps.cue: Slow, easy lengths.
